market.what: online ammonia/ammonium measurement for wastewater (analyzers + ISE electrodes), world
market.method: online NH3-N analyzer report $185M (2025) + est. ISE electrode refills ~$65M (est. 60k probes x NH4 + K electrodes at ~$525 each every 18-24 months)

value.logic: US aeration power $1.43B/yr; world est. 4x = $5.7B. ABAC saves 10-20%. K-proof ISE lets ABAC run near 0-1 mg/L on est. 25% more load: $5.7B x 25% x 12% = $170M; plus no K compensation electrode (~$525) and fewer wet analyzers (~$30M est.)
value.revenue_logic: est. 40k ammonium electrodes/yr x ~$150 K14 share (ionophore supply/license to OEMs)
value.margin_logic: ionophore is mg per electrode; sold as licensed consumable

trend.drivers: WWTP energy cost; N limits (EU UWWTD recast N removal at >=150k PE); ABAC adoption; fertigation/hydroponics sensing
trend.deadline: 2039: EU UWWTD tertiary (N) treatment at plants >=150k PE

competition.notes: Nonactin is the standard ionophore, log K(NH4,K) only -0.9 to -1.3, so OEMs add a K compensation electrode. Best academic crown ethers ~6x10^-2. No funded startup found on the ionophore itself

lab.synth: 3-5 step custom (est.): tripodal/crown-type receptor, no early example yet; 3 variants
lab.test: PVC-membrane ISE; IUPAC selectivity log K(NH4,K) target < -2.5 (nonactin -0.9 to -1.3); drift in real influent; university electrochemistry lab
lab.logic: synth 10 wk + electrode tests 4 wk; 2-3 variants x $10-15k synth + ~$15k testing

sale.gates: OEM field trial 6-12 months (electrode life >=12 months); OEM product release cycle ~1 yr
